dedupe_keys.name: hub eau open apis of the french water information system

description: Hub'Eau is the national set of open REST APIs that serves public data from France's water information system, published by BRGM as a lasting service of the eaufrance network. Thirteen APIs cover hydrometry, groundwater levels, river and groundwater quality, drinking water quality control results by commune, annual water abstractions, river temperature, visual flow observations on small rivers, coastal water monitoring, hydrobiology, fish surveys, pesticide sales and water and sanitation service indicators. The hydrometry API draws on the national HYDRO platform run by the Vigicrues central service: near real-time water levels and flows from about 5,000 stations recorded every 5 to 60 minutes and kept for one month, plus daily and monthly flows over the full record, back to 1900 at some of more than 4,200 stations. Other APIs report volumes such as 120 million drinking water analyses and 1.1 million annual abstraction volumes. Responses come as JSON, GeoJSON, CSV or XML, with no registration, and data are reusable under the Etalab Licence Ouverte, including commercially, with attribution. Caveats: real-time series are provisional and short, users must page and filter large queries, and coverage mirrors the underlying databases. Simulation uses: live feeds for flood and drought early warning and digital twins of rivers and supply systems, abstraction and quality inputs for drinking water and irrigation scenarios. Related records: the SISPEA observatory (data-sispea-french-water-services-observatory) behind the service indicators API and the French wastewater treatment portal (data-france-collective-sanitation-portal-wwtp).
